newsitem.title: BURMA: Burma seizes nearly one million amphetamine tablets.
newsitem.headline: Burma seizes nearly one million amphetamine tablets.

text.p: Burmese officials said on Thursday they arrested a suspected drug trafficker and seized nearly one million tablets of amphetamines in eastern Shan State near the Thai border.
A statement issued by the Burmese government said officials were still in pursuit of two suspected accomplices relating to the drug seizure.
Thai narcotics officials estimate about 20 million tablets of amphetamines a year are smuggled into Thailand from neighbouring countries.
They estimate that about 200,000 young Thais, mostly schoolchildren, are addicted to amphetamines.
